titulo: A mysterious twist in the universe’s oldest light could reveal new physics
resumo: Scientists have spotted hints of a mysterious rotation in the universe’s oldest light that could reveal new physics and shed light on dark matter and dark energy. A new technique developed at UC San Diego could help rule out misleading telescope errors, bringing researchers closer to determining whether the strange signal is real.

titulo: Scientists tracked kids for 8 years. What they found about screen time was surprising
resumo: A surprising Finnish study found that children who spent more time using screens tended to have better cognitive processing abilities as teenagers, challenging the assumption that screen time is always harmful. Researchers suggest that what children do on screens may matter more than how much time they spend using them.

titulo: NHS data contract to stay with Palantir until 2029
resumo: Despite calls from some Labour MPs to end the arrangement with Palantir, ministers say a new contract will not be awarded until 2029.

titulo: NASA is offering $1 million for bold ideas to help build a Moon base
resumo: NASA is offering $1 million in its new Moon Base Challenge, inviting U.S. students to develop innovative solutions for building humanity’s first permanent lunar outpost. From power systems to astronaut safety, their ideas could help make long-term life on the Moon possible and pave the way to Mars.

titulo: NASA smashed into an asteroid. Now Hera has revealed a strange new world
resumo: A European spacecraft has revealed a mysterious, crater-covered side of the asteroid Didymos as it prepares to investigate the aftermath of NASA’s historic 2022 asteroid impact. The mission could uncover new clues about the collision and help turn asteroid deflection into a powerful defense against future threats to Earth.
